title.narrative: Strengthening Public Sector Management Program, Subprogram 1

description.narrative: The proposed program supports improved governance and accountability across the public sector in Papua New Guinea by improving fiscal management, enhancing state-owned enterprise (SOE) governance, and strengthening accountability institutions through three mutually reinforcing reform areas. The program will be financed through two policy-based loans of $100 million for subprogram 1 in 2024 and, indicatively, $150 million for subprogram 2 in 2026. The program builds on and expands the scope of reforms supported through previous Asian Development Bank (ADB) policy-based lending (PBL).

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

1.1. To improve domestic resource mobilization and create space for essential development spending, (i) NEC adopted the Medium-term Revenue Strategy 2023-2027 (MTRS) in October 2023 that encompasses all main revenue collecting agencies and taxes and identifies legal, regulatory and institutional reforms needed to improve revenue collections; (ii) the Non-tax Revenue Act 2022 was gazetted on 21 April 2023, which will centralize statutory bodies' revenues into the Consolidated Revenue Fund to improve governance and accountability in the management of non-tax revenues; and (iii) the Treasurer approved NTRA determination agreements for 13 (out of 24) statutory authorities that collect non-tax revenue as part of a phased arrangement to implement the NTRA Act.

1.2. To enhance macro-fiscal stability through enhanced debt management, the DoT operationalized a new fit-for-purpose debt management system, and completed the migration of debt data, including information on government guarantees.
1.3. To enhance climate resilience of land transport network in PNG, DOWH adopted a prioritized plan to implement the department's Climate Change Policy.
